verdict.rationale: Docs confirm API-driven activation, suspension (pause), and permanent closing of cards via the paymentInstrument resource (docs-10,17,18,19), and unpausing is implied by re-activation. However, there is no evidence of an explicit 'report lost or stolen' status/endpoint or a 'reissue with replacement linked to original card' workflow. Missing for 10: explicit lost/stolen reporting API, reissue-with-linkage API, and any independent/hands-on confirmation beyond first-party docs.
